title: Merit badge tags
description: Subject facets for grouping and browsing the merit badge catalog (multi-valued on merit-badge.tags). Facets, not a taxonomy: a badge normally carries two or three, because most badges sit in more than one subject area (Oceanography is stem and nature; Lifesaving is aquatics and safety). Two pairs carry `broader` so a coarse filter still reaches them: shooting_sports rolls up to sports, handicraft to arts. These are OUR groupings for navigation - Scouting America publishes no official badge categories - so they are descriptive, not authoritative.

terms.label: Animals
terms.description: Caring for, training, or working with domestic animals and livestock.

terms.label: Aquatics
terms.description: In, on, or under the water: swimming, small craft, and diving.

terms.label: Arts and Media
terms.description: Visual, performing, and communication arts, including film, music, and the written word.

terms.label: Business and Career
terms.description: Enterprise, money management, selling, and the skills of working life.

terms.label: Citizenship and Law
terms.description: How communities, nations, and legal systems work, and a Scout's part in them.

terms.label: Collecting
terms.description: Building, organizing, and studying a collection.

terms.label: Handicraft
terms.description: Making objects by hand from raw material - carving, weaving, moulding, tooling.

terms.label: Health and Medicine
terms.description: Personal fitness, public health, and the medical and dental professions.

terms.label: Heritage and Culture
terms.description: History, cultures, ancestry, and the record of the past - including Scouting's own.

terms.label: Nature and Conservation
terms.description: Living things and the systems that sustain them, and the work of conserving both.

terms.label: Outdoor Skills
terms.description: Travelling, camping, and looking after yourself away from home.

terms.label: Safety and Emergency Response
terms.description: Preventing harm and responding when it happens, from first aid to search and rescue.

terms.label: Shooting Sports
terms.description: Marksmanship with bow, rifle, or shotgun.

terms.label: Sports and Games
terms.description: Athletic pursuits and games of skill.

terms.label: Science, Technology and Engineering
terms.description: Science, computing, engineering, and the built and designed world.

terms.label: Trades and Mechanics
terms.description: Skilled trades, machinery, transport, and industrial processes.
